title: Redis / background executor

split_lanes.label: Split lanes
split_lanes.help: Separate light/default/heavy queues. When enabled, workers must be 1; readiness is checked separately per lane.

workers.label: Workers
workers.help: Default 3 workers; range 1 to 10. max_running independently limits simultaneous jobs. Split lanes require workers=1.

max_pending.label: Max pending
max_pending.help: Maximum queued jobs; admission beyond this limit is refused.

max_running.label: Max running
max_running.help: Global simultaneous job cap across queues. Increasing workers alone does not increase this cap.

retention_seconds.label: Retention seconds
retention_seconds.help: Seconds to keep detailed logs and artifacts after completion. Default 3600 = one hour.

redis_memory_mb.label: Redis memory mb
redis_memory_mb.help: Redis RAM limit in MiB; this is not a disk-space limit.

visibility_timeout_seconds.label: Visibility timeout seconds
visibility_timeout_seconds.help: Broker visibility timeout; keep it longer than the longest permitted task to avoid premature redelivery.

port.label: Dashboard host port
port.help: Dashboard host port; choose a free port. It is separate from the browser terminal port.

help: Runs Redis, background workers and an executor dashboard inside Orcan.
Workers are available execution slots; max_running is a shared job limit. Jobs may still use multiple build threads.
Finish active jobs before changing settings that recreate the container. Shared CPU/RAM limits apply to all workers.
Check after startup: orcan executor doctor; inspect queue limits with orcan executor settings.
